risks.risk: Publishing two-domain accuracy with no reviewed job-posting corpus
risks.mitigation: Block headline claims until corpus minimum and review gates pass.
risks.trigger: Any README/report update with two-domain numbers

risks.risk: Hallucination rate diluted by all-fields denominator
risks.mitigation: Use expected-null opportunities and null-correct counts.
Layer extraction outcome and semantic scoring; add strict document success.
Surface billed cost in error payload and journal every attempt.

risks.risk: Interrupted paid run loses in-memory evidence
risks.mitigation: Append-only journal with fsync and hash-validated resume.
Frozen manifest and per-result consistency checks.

risks.risk: Unauthenticated public exposure causes paid-call abuse
risks.mitigation: Gateway-only binding, TLS, auth, rate limits and upstream budget.

risks.risk: Untrusted PDF consumes CPU/memory or exploits parser surface
risks.mitigation: Gateway size limit, container limits, read-only filesystem, timeout and isolated preprocessor if public.
Treat as benchmark safety only; gateway/shared store owns production quota.
risks.trigger: More than one process or restart-sensitive budget

risks.mitigation: Keep single-process boundary; add atomic reservation before scaling.

risks.risk: v1 total-only convention contradicts never-infer prompt
risks.mitigation: Disclose convention, avoid new total-only fixtures, design invoice.v2 after baseline.

risks.risk: Agents act on stale STATUS/PLAN/ADR claims
risks.mitigation: Canonical state file and drift checks.
Audit global adapter, pin digests, gated canonical matrix.

risks.risk: Not every CI action is immutable-SHA pinned and Docker check is not a required branch check
risks.mitigation: Pin third-party actions and require the Docker job or aggregate required gate.

risks.risk: Presence heuristic is mistaken for calibrated confidence
risks.mitigation: Rename to field_presence or remove before formal consumers.
